notes: Derived edit through the transitivity of located_in (the definitional premise 'a building is in the region that contains its town' is that property), as geography-replace-0015. Since 2026-10-31 every firm fact is a bridge of the record: 'Nestlé's headquarters lies in only one canton or département' (one_region, a rule about the headquarters; the general one-country rule was not needed and is gone), 'the canton of Vaud is in Switzerland' (vaud_ch), 'Haute-Savoie is in France', 'France is a member of the EU' (located_in(france, eu)) and 'Switzerland is not a member of the EU' (ch_not_eu, a rule). The adds hold only the side facts the worlds name, not the answer (FINDINGS E): w1, the headquarters stands in some other town, in some region (placeholders); w2, Vevey lies in some region (a placeholder). Haute-Savoie then follows from the edit, transitivity and the one-region rule.

queries.find: nestle_hq : located_in some (City and located_in value ?)
